Grab either bob and pull it aside (the twin sits dead still); let go and watch the glowing fluid pour from one vial to the other over T_beat/2 — nobody touching it. The amber coupling spring heats up exactly when the bobs are most out of step. release together → they swing in lockstep, the spring never stretches, no trade; release mirrored → they scissor, the spring pulses hottest, still no trade — a single pull is just ½ of each beating. Turn K down and the trade goes lazy; freeze the coupling (K→0) and each vial holds its level forever. Small-angle frame; the trade is exact there. ↔  The Singing Glass — one oscillator driven to run away; here two trade ω₁,ω₂ instead. ↔  The Beating Bench — two close MODES beating is exactly what two close tones sound like.
